Basic BIDS Compliance Checks

Source: R/bids.R
bids_check_compliance.Rd

Performs a lightweight check of common BIDS requirements:

  • dataset_description.json must exist at the dataset root (an issue if missing).

  • participants.tsv, README/README.md, and CHANGES are recommended (a warning if missing).

  • Every participant must have a sub-<label> directory.

  • If sessions are present, session directories must be named ses-<label>.

  • Optionally, file names are checked against the vendored BIDS schema (see bids_schema()); mismatches are reported as warnings.

Usage

bids_check_compliance(x, schema_check = TRUE, schema_version = "1.10.0")

Arguments

x

A bids_project object.

schema_check

Logical. Whether to run schema validation (default TRUE). If the requested schema version is not available, schema validation is skipped and schema_checked is FALSE.

schema_version

Character. BIDS schema version to use (default "1.10.0", the version vendored with bidser; see bids_schema_versions()).

Value

A list with:

  • passed (logical): TRUE if no issues were found.

  • issues (character): descriptions of failed requirements.

  • warnings (character): missing recommended files and schema warnings.

  • participants_source (character): where participant IDs came from.

  • schema_checked (logical): whether schema validation ran.

Details

This is not a full BIDS validator. For complete validation, use the official BIDS validator.

Examples

# \donttest{
tryCatch({
  ds001_path <- get_example_bids_dataset("ds001")
  proj <- bids_project(ds001_path)
  compliance <- bids_check_compliance(proj)
}, error = function(e) {
  message("Example requires internet connection: ", e$message)
})
# }
